intro: Taming the Beast is the culmination of a hunter's early training in Elwynn Forest, overseen by Josephine Carson. After demonstrating mastery over boars and wolves, hunters are tasked with using a Taming Rod to pacify and gain the trust of a Young Forest Bear. This final trial deepens a hunter's attunement to beasts and maintains the woodland's natural balance through respect and skill.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf. Now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion.
Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Go forth, friend, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The brawn of the forest. Brave work, friend!
